videos.title: 志愿者说：从工程师到教师，技术一直在路上
videos.title_en: From Engineer to Teacher, My Journey in Technology Continues.
videos.description: 西安—呼和浩特段的技术担当是矽递前员工。身份在变，对技术的热爱未变
videos.description_en: The person in charge of technology for the Xi'an–Hohhot route is a former Seeed Studio engineer. While the job title may have changed, the love for technology has never wavered.

videos.title: 生物老师跨界玩数字制造
videos.title_en: A Biology Teacher Turns Digital Maker
videos.description: 用激光切割复刻中国古建筑，把传统建筑文化变成可触摸、可体验的作品。
videos.description_en: Recreating classical Chinese architecture with a laser cutter, turning built heritage into something you can hold.

videos.title: 从丝路古道到 AI 时代，甘肃正在焕新
videos.title_en: From the Silk Road to the AI Era
videos.description: 从农业生产到乡村建设，AI 正在这片古老的土地上连接传统与未来。
videos.description_en: From farming to rural development, AI is connecting tradition and the future on this ancient land.

videos.title: 当 AI 走进新疆，一场农业革命正在发生
videos.description: AI 走进果园，机器人帮着采摘、管理与监测，科技从实验室进入田间地头。
videos.description_en: AI enters the orchards: robots help with picking, management and monitoring, moving technology from the lab into the fields.

videos.title: 318科技纪事：把科技带向远方
videos.title_en: Tech Chronicles of Route 318: Taking Innovation to the Frontier
videos.description: 不断遇见，不断帮助，基地车 G318 之旅留下的精彩瞬间。
videos.description_en: Meeting people, lending a hand: highlights from the vehicle's journey along the G318.
